text:
penny: Quick FYI — running into a weird one with multipart uploads in the Android SDK. When uploading large files with a chunked multipart body, network hiccup + token refresh causes duplicate partial uploads. Happens more often on Android 13/14 when using foreground service vs normal Activity.

yoav: can you paste the client config and the error?

penny: builder: 
```
OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .callTimeout(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
  .writeTimeout(0, TimeUnit.SECONDS) // streaming
  .connectionPool(ConnectionPool(3, 2, TimeUnit.MINUTES))
  .build()
```
stack trace (truncated):
```
E/OkHttp: java.io.IOException: connection aborted
   at okhttp3.internal.connection.ExchangeFinder.findConnection(ExchangeFinder.kt:...)
   at okhttp3.internal.http2.Http2Stream.read(Http2Stream.kt:...)
Caused by: java.net.SocketException: Software caused connection abort
```
When this happens our retry layer issues a fresh POST to the same upload endpoint. Server accepts repeated partial chunks (no idempotency token) and ends up assembling duplicates. Also saw concurrent token refresh requests when a 401 returned during retry, so two refreshes race and both retry the upload.

tricia: ack. two separate things to tackle: (A) multipart/streaming requests should be non-retriable by default unless caller sets idempotency token, (B) singleflight token refresh so only one refresh happens concurrently.

penny: agree. also curious whether changing callTimeout semantics helps — callTimeout may wrap the entire streaming lifecycle and cause surprising cancel semantics on network change. On Android 14 foreground service the system seems to tear sockets faster, so OkHttp surfaces SocketException -> canceled.

yoav: quick mitigation suggestions:
- Set retryOnConnectionFailure(false) for streaming uploads in SDK defaults.
- Add an UploadPolicy that requires idempotency-key header for automatic retries.
- Implement singleflight around token refresh (synchronized coroutine / mutex) so duplicate refresh HTTP calls are coalesced.

tricia: also add EventListener attach points to capture cancellation reason strings ("Socket closed", "Connection abort") and emit FailureReason tags in telemetry. Helps decide whether to backoff or bubble up to app.

jenkins-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-714: "Android SDK: multipart upload duplicates on network hiccup + token refresh; add non-retriable streaming default + singleflight refresh" (<https://issues.redwood/DEVEX-714>) :spiral_note_pad:

penny: i'll prototype: change streaming default to retryOnConnectionFailure(false), inject idempotency-key requirement for auto-retries, and add singleflight for refresh. Will attach a small sample that simulates mid-upload network drop via `adb shell svc wifi disable` and show server-side reassembly.

yoav: thanks — also update onboarding guide with a short note on streaming uploads and foreground-service differences on Android 13/14.

tricia: once PR is up i'll validate across Pixel 4a/6/7 on Android 11-14 and run the sample with WorkManager/foreground service toggles.

penny: sounds good. will link PR and test artifacts to DEVEX-714.
